message: Vector Rebel 3.2.53 beta corrects SCBA Face Mask alphanumeric serial verification when Vector clips the PPE name.
releaseNotes: Baldree v3.2.52 Tour ran through the structural PPE entries but failed on SCBA Face Mask with list label E004015306F73814... and detail heading plus labeled serial E004015306F73814. The prior name restorer required a numeric-only serial token, incorrectly rejecting this exact alphanumeric serial. 3.2.53 compares the independently labeled exact serial to a complete token in the list stem and complete matching item heading, retaining route/type/full-name verification. Negative tests reject numeric substring, near-collision serials, wrong equipment, conflicting titles, and missing serial. PASS/FAIL must reflect actual physical inspection, no automatic certification. Live attended field acceptance remains pending.
